claims.text: The five firms define and report advisor headcount differently: Morgan Stanley reports Wealth Management representatives, Edward Jones reports Financial advisors (actual), Merrill (Bank of America) reports Total wealth advisors across GWIM and Consumer Banking, Raymond James reports Total advisors as the sum of employee and independent contractor advisors, and Schwab publishes no dedicated advisor headcount figure.

In its 2023 fourth-quarter financial supplement, Bank of America reports a Total wealth advisors figure at period end, defined as including advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
Raymond James reports Total advisors as the sum of employee financial advisors and independent contractor financial advisors.
Raymond James excludes financial advisors associated with firms in its RCS division from its financial advisor counts, although their client assets are included in AUA.
Morgan Stanley reported 15,950 Wealth Management representatives for the quarter ended December 31, 2020.
Edward Jones reported 20,514 financial advisors at period end June 26, 2026.
Bank of America reported Total wealth advisors at period end of 18,916 at December 31, 2023, defined as including advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
Raymond James reported 8,943 total financial advisors as of September 30, 2025, comprising 3,878 employee financial advisors and 5,065 independent contractor financial advisors.
Schwab states that growth in its headcount includes growth in financial consultants and wealth advisors, attributed to supporting its expanding client base.
Schwab describes its investor-facing advisory roles as Financial Consultants, Active Trader Financial Consultants, and Wealth Consultants, who provide guidance and relationship management.
Bank of America's Total wealth advisors figure includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
Raymond James reports its financial advisor headcount as the sum of employee financial advisors and independent contractor financial advisors, shown as Total advisors.
As of September 30, 2025, Raymond James had approximately 19,500 associates (including 3,878 employee financial advisors) and 5,065 independent advisors.
Raymond James's independent contractor financial advisors, which it calls independent advisors, are included in its advisor counts.

Raymond James states that financial advisors associated with firms in its RCS (RIA & Custody Services) division are not included in its financial advisor counts, although their client assets are included in AUA.
Morgan Stanley disclosed Wealth Management representatives of 15,950 as of December 31, 2020 in its Wealth Management Metrics.

Schwab's filings attribute compensation and benefits expense growth to growth in headcount, including financial consultants and wealth advisors, without disclosing a specific advisor headcount figure.
Schwab's Form ADV Part 1A reports 30,690 employees, defined as including full- and part-time employees but excluding clerical workers.
Schwab's Form ADV Part 1A reports 4,127 employees perform investment advisory functions (including research) and 6,584 are investment adviser representatives.
Edward Jones reports financial advisor headcount as Financial advisors (actual), disclosing both the count at period end and the average for the period, split between U.S. and Canada segments.
At year end 2025, Edward Jones reported 20,425 financial advisors, with 19,540 in the U.S. segment and 885 in the Canada segment.

Bank of America's Global Wealth & Investment Management Key Indicators report advisor headcount as Total wealth advisors at period end, defined as including advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
Raymond James reports advisor headcount as Financial advisors, broken into Employees and Independent contractors with a Total advisors line, as of each September 30.
Advisors in Raymond James's RCS division are not included in its financial advisor metric, although their client assets are included in PCG AUA.
